4:3.en: you will be able to do justice

4:24.en: And (prohibited are) the ones who are married

4:49.en: (even as much as) a hair on a date-seed

4:53.en: (even as much as the) speck on a date seed

4:68.en: And We would have guided them

4:77.en: (even as much as) a hair on a date-seed

4:90.en: surely He (would have) given them power
and surely they (would have) fought you

4:119.en: And I will surely mislead them
and surely arouse desires in them
and surely I will order them
so they will surely cut off
and surely I will order them

4:124.en: (even as much as) the speck on a date-seed

4:127.en: and the ones who are weak

4:172.en: the ones who are near (to Allah)

4:173.en: then He will give them in full
